plan.title: Invite one named vendor to eRFX RFQ

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Configure the project with RFQ as its only stage.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item with quantity 10.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite only the named Vendor A on the create screen.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants list.
Assert that exactly one vendor is a participant.
Assert that the sole participant is the named Vendor A.
